routes.notes: Private urban bus (full-size buses; operator 'City Tour', fleet 83 buses: 70 diesel, 13 CNG) on a stage-carriage route gazetted in the Punjab Gazette of June 2006 (route data from DRTA Gujranwala). Marked 'Operational' in the 2017 paper; survey figures: 35 buses, avg headway 8 min, 235 trips/day, 18,051 passengers/day (bus count at General Bus Stand). Only endpoints are given (Fig. 1 map shows the alignment but lists no stops). Current status unknown - probably defunct or replaced, as the paper describes the service as failing; check before publishing. Not a wagon/Qingqi route.

notes: Only source with route IDs: the 2017 MUET paper (Table 1). It lists 8 stage-carriage routes gazetted June 2006. Four were operational in 2017 and are included above. The four listed as NON-OPERATIONAL in 2017 are left out of routes: B3 Aziz Cross (Pindi Bye-pass) - WAPDA Town; B6 Behari Colony - Rahwali Cantt; B7 Zamindara Stand - Dharam Kot Chowk; B8 Tatley Aali - Aziz Cross. Same paper: Qingqis have 'no specified routes'. About 16,000 passengers/day use Qingqis/rickshaws illegally along GT Road between Chanda Qilla and Pindi Bypass, with most boarding between Sheikhupura Morr and Gondlanwala. Urban Unit 2021 Connectivity Plan (83 pp, text extracted): has no intra-city route table. Its data-request annex only lists items it asked the Secretary DRTA for (intra-city route map, route permits by mode, bus stops, Qingqi route details); none of these are published in the plan. TPU Gujranwala study page: summary only, no routes and no PDF. Transport Dept bus-terminal PDFs (transport.punjab.gov.pk/system/files/Gujranwala.pdf and 'Gujranwala Bus Stand_0.pdf') returned 403. punjabtransport.org route-notification page refused connection. MUET article HTML/PDF blocks WebFetch (403) but opens with a browser user agent. OSM Overpass: no bus/minibus/share_taxi route relations in the Gujranwala bbox. English/Urdu searches found no numbered wagon/Hiace/Qingqi route lists or stop sequences (Dawn 2004 archive, Dunya city pages, Nawa-i-Waqt, Graana, UrduPoint). Excluded: Gujranwala Mass Transit/metro feeder (government), UMT university shuttle.
